title: Chapter 192: New Lineup To Fight Against The Demon Clan Again
content:
Chapter 192: New Lineup To Fight Against The Demon Clan Again

"Friends of the Tengu clan, please don't panic. I came from the Zerg clan and was ordered to pick up a few people. I will leave soon!"

The transport host shook the air with three-star super spiritual power and said these words to the whole city.

This may sound like a polite statement, but in fact it is a shameless slap in the face of the Tengu clan.

The Zerg tribe can enter the large cities of the Tengu tribe silently. If a war breaks out, wouldn't they be at the mercy of others?

"Goshu, please practice again from now on. The lord has sent someone to pick you up!"

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights interrupted the cultivation of Gou Shu and others. Those who had obtained the inheritance of the Nine Transformations of the Celestial Silkworm all exited their cultivation state and watched in amazement as the huge body of the transport host descended from the sky.

People around the square, and even everyone in the city who could see the transport host, craned their necks to watch the huge and domineering UFO land.

"This is my Zerg's transport unit. You can get your things and go up there. It will take you to the Zerg territory. When you get to the Daxia Territory, someone will make arrangements for you!"

Captain Tiancan Knight said to Gou Shu and his family.

Gou Shu and his young fiancee, feeling both anxious and excited, boarded the transport host's load through the tentacles extended by the transport host hovering over the square under the gaze of thousands of people. space.

The transport host retracts its tentacles, closes the hatch, and accelerates directly.

It only took a very short time for its huge body to go from a static state to flying at high speed. Everyone only heard a "swish" sound, and the huge thing hovering in the air flew away far away. It didn't take long before it disappeared. On the horizon.

The transport host, representing the Zerg tribe, took the initiative to show off its muscles in the large cities of the Tengu tribe.

Ordinary people saw a lively and knowledgeable person and saw the great strength of the Zerg.

The Zerg have such a powerful troop carrier, and anyone who offends the Zerg must be careful. This flying troop carrier that comes and goes without a trace and is extremely fast can send the strong Zerg to the enemy at any time.

By the time the Tengu defenders in the city rushed to the square, the transport host had already flown no matter how far they had flown, and they could only return in frustration.

"We will only stay in this city for one day and will leave early tomorrow morning. Other Celestial Silkworm Knights will pass by in the future. Those who are interested in obtaining the inheritance can continue to test!"

As soon as the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights said this, many people who were still hesitating immediately took action and ran forward to test.

The people tested at this time were people of various identities. People from every class were dissatisfied with their own situation. Everyone's pursuit was different, and many people had the idea of changing the status quo.

The inheritance of the Zerg Clan's Nine Transformations Technique is an opportunity to change the status quo, and the brave are willing to take a gamble.

The test has already begun since he learned the news about the inheritance. If he doesn't have the determination and courage to come forward for the test, then he is definitely not the person Wu Qing is looking for.

The test speed of the ten Celestial Silkworm Knights was very fast, and many people completed the test with a simple question.

As the identities of the people who came to take the test became more complicated, more and more people failed the test. These people were unwilling to accept the test and did not know where they fell short.

But no one dared to cause trouble. Without the burden of Gou Shu, the combat power of this group of Celestial Silkworm Knights was not weak. Most people could not deal with them, and those who could deal with them did not dare to do anything.

The Zerg territory is not far from here, and the transport host just put a lot of pressure on everyone.

This team of ten Celestial Silkworm Knights sowed the seeds of the Zerg in this large city of the Tengu Clan and established rules.

From now on, the world will have a loose organization linked by the inheritance of the Zerg Celestial Silkworm's Nine Transformations Technique. No matter what their identities are, these people will be labeled with Zerg-related labels.

As the number of people receiving inheritance increases, this will be a powerful force that cannot be ignored.

The other nine teams of Celestial Silkworm Knights continue to walk and improve the map while looking for suitable cities to spread the inheritance of Celestial Silkworm's Nine Transformations Technique.

As time goes by and after enough experience and lessons have been learned, Wu Qing will send out a larger group of Celestial Silkworm Knights.

…

The frontline city in the Naga territory just captured an important castle of the Demon clan yesterday, completely reversing the situation where the Naga clan had been passively being beaten.

The entire city was filled with the joy of victory. The surviving puppies of the Zerg tribe, the important contributors to this war, stayed in the comfortable military camp, fully absorbing the energy coins provided by the Naga tribe.

The third batch of reinforcements from the Zerg tribe arrived outside the city about an hour later than expected by the Naga tribe.

When more than 300,000 Zerg troops appeared outside the city, the last worry of the Naga tribe disappeared.

With this Zerg support army, the Naga tribe can immediately switch from defense to offense and gradually expand the Naga tribe's advantage.

The Zerg reinforcements did not enter the city, but stayed outside the city. Nagaya went out to greet them personally with people and gifts, and Host No. 3 also accompanied them outside the city.

"No. 3, we listened to your advice and only prepared luck beads as gifts. Except for the necessary strategic luck beads, I shipped them all for you!"

"More luck beads will take time to prepare!"

Nagaya directed people to carry out boxes of luck beads. At a glance, there were at least three times more than yesterday.

Wu Qing is very satisfied with this quantity!

"The gift is already very generous. The Zerg army is here to fight. Please give the elders an order to help the Zerg army find a suitable target. It's not too late to fight now!"

"This reinforcements, with the cooperation of several powerful units of the Zerg tribe, are enough to fight alone!"

Wu Qing said to Nagaya through Host No. 3.

"Today I will accompany you to attack a target, and tomorrow you will fight alone. I happen to be leaving tomorrow too!"

Nagaya did not agree with the Zerg army to fight alone today, but wanted to see the combat power of this Zerg army with her own eyes before making a decision.

Wu Qing did not insist that the Zerg army could not fight alone. As long as the Zerg army showed its strength on the battlefield, it would be enough to fight alone.

The transport host flew forward, moved boxes of luck beads into the loading space, and flew away!

Only the resources transported to the Zerg territory are truly obtained resources.

With this batch of luck beads, the Zerg tribe will be more confident.

"Tell me! Where to hit!"

"Don't you need to take a rest?"

"unnecessary!"

"Walk!"

Seeing that the Zerg are eager to fight, Nagaya doesn't talk nonsense. She feels that her luck must have increased greatly recently, otherwise she would not have such a caring ally!

The Zerg army passed around the city, and the Zerg puppies in the city also headed east out of the city and met up with the large army outside the city.

Nagaya brought only 5,000 Naga warriors and 10,000 Yu clan horse archers this time to lead the Zerg army forward.

"The target this time is also a demon castle, but the scale is much smaller than the castle attacked yesterday!"

"The demon army stationed inside should be less than 300,000, and there aren't many powerful troops!"

"I hope they will be brave enough to go out to fight, otherwise it will be a bit troublesome to attack the city. My siege weapons here are out of ammunition!"

Nagaya walked quickly while talking to Host No. 3 flying beside her.

"It doesn't matter, our reinforcements this time include siege troops!"

Host No. 3 responded truthfully.

Nagaya looked back at the tall Destroyer in the Zerg army. Judging from the appearance, the Zerg siege unit must be the Destroyer.

"You Zerg are such a strange race. While the essence remains unchanged, your external forms are so diverse!"

"You have implemented the concept that the body is a weapon to the extreme!"

Nagaya has been in contact with the Zerg for two days and has a relatively in-depth understanding of the Zerg.

"This is the evolutionary direction of the Zerg race. It has advantages and disadvantages. It cannot be said to be good or bad."

"..."

In this way, Wu Qing chatted with Nagaya through Host No. 3, getting the information they wanted from each other.

After more than an hour of rapid march, another demon castle appeared in front of the Zerg army.

This demon castle is at least half the size of the castle they attacked yesterday, and its construction is even more crude.

Without any nonsense, the Zerg army marched directly into the formation of the Demon Clan's castle. Among the Demon Clan's army, only the three-star Flame Demon had an ultra-long range, which may not be found in this castle. The Zerg were not afraid of the Demon Clan's long-range attacks at all.

Even if there are three-star flame demons in this demonic castle, the Zerg's explosive mosquitoes have already flown to high altitudes, waiting for the three-star flame demons to appear in order to kill them in advance.

The demons here, whether because of their twisted self-esteem or because they are overconfident in their own strength, are really not prepared to fight to defend the city.

Of course, Wu Qing would not miss such a good thing. He commanded the Zerg to form a formation, waiting for the demon army to leave the city and arrange their troops.

After waiting for a long time, the demon clan's army has basically left the city, with a strength of nearly 300,000. Among them, the number of the backbone army of dog demons is not large.

The combined army of the Zerg and Naga tribes has tens of thousands more troops than the demon army. The difference in strength between the two sides is not very obvious.

The war begins!

The front line composed of three thousand cockroaches and Zerg puppies remained motionless, while the five hundred saboteurs at the rear of the formation took the lead in attacking.

Five hundred huge liquid fireballs were sprayed high into the sky, directed towards the formation of the demon army in the distance. The demon army, which was unable to react, watched helplessly as the liquid fireball fell into the formation.

"Boom boom...!"

After the violent explosion, overwhelming corrosive liquid fell.

Even with the demon clan's defense capabilities and fire resistance, they could not withstand the damage of such a mixed attack. A large number of demon clan soldiers turned into light and disappeared, and there were countless injured demon clan soldiers.

"This is much easier to use than siege weapons!"

Nagaya couldn't help but sigh when she saw the destroyer's attack.
